sn35.79:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3
sn35.79:1.2: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.79:1.3: Atthi nu kho bhante eko dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || ||
sn35.79:2.1: Atthi kho bhikkhu kho dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || 4
sn35.79:3.1: Katamo pana bhante eko dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || ||
sn35.79:4.1: Avijjā kho bhikkhu eko dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || 5
sn35.79:5.1: Katham pana bhante jānato katham passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajatīti || || 6
sn35.79:6.1: Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || Rūpe || la ||
sn35.79:6.2: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjati || || 7-11 Jivhā ||
sn35.79:6.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || 1-5
